request.subject: PORTRAIT:DWARF:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Turn it into a steam paddle boat: the hull becomes soot-black riveted iron #3a3835 with a light grey #8a8580 rim; the red sail, mast and pennant become one tall copper #d06a2a smokestack puffing white steam; add a copper paddle wheel and a small bright green #2bd94a lamp. Nothing red. Keep the boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
